basic_info.description: Price Reduced! Location, location! Live your best Marina life in this sweet and spacious 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom renovated condo. Built in 1992, this boutique 12-unit building offers modern amenities in an unbeatable Marina district location. The open-concept layout features sparkling wide plank hardwood floors, a galley kitchen with modern countertops, granite flooring, and stainless-steel appliances, including a gas range/oven & Bosch dishwasher, and a breakfast bar that seamlessly opens to the living room. East-facing windows line the walls of the dining and living areas, offering calm natural light. A peaceful bedroom retreat boasts hardwood floors and two spacious closets. The bathroom includes a shower-over-tub, gorgeous vanity with new lighting above, and hexagon tile flooring. Additional features include new paint throughout, a mixture of modern light fixtures & recessed lighting, and brand new cabinet & door hardware. Convenient shared laundry is located downstairs. Enjoy a communal rooftop deck with views of the Golden Gate Bridge and the bay. Located just steps from the Marina Green, Crissy Field, the beach, and close proximity to Chestnut Street's shops and cafes, perfectly positioning you to enjoy all the landmarks in one of San Francisco's most desirable neighborhoods
